verdict.rationale: EBANX documents local-currency acceptance (ebanx-docs-34) and local payment methods across markets such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia and Turkey through a single API (ebanx-docs-18, ebanx-docs-19). It also documents real-time balance and settlement-history tracking (ebanx-docs-4). However, nothing in the pack explicitly covers cross-border settlement in the merchant's home currency or how FX rates and fees are disclosed. missing for 10: documented settlement to the merchant's bank in their own currency, transparent FX rate/fee handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
